data.long_meaning: Adiyah is an Arabic name that is unisex. It is derived from the word 'adiy, which means 'devoted, kind, spiritual'. The name Adiyah carries the meaning “Devoted, Kind, Spiritual” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Adiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody devoted, kind, spiritual and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Devotion, kindness, and spirituality are highly valued in Islamic tradition, making Adiyah a meaningful name for both girls and boys.
data.etymology: Adiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Devoted, Kind, Spiritual.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adiyah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
